subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me a 6-mark exam-style question on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a worked example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: A 750 g pack of rice costs £1.80 and a 500 g pack costs £1.30. Which is better value per 100 g?
questions.explain: 750 g pack is 24p per 100 g versus 26p per 100 g for the 500 g pack, so the 750 g pack is better value.

questions.q: A car travels 150 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
Share £60 between Amy and Ben in the ratio 2 : 3. How much does Ben get?
questions.explain: Total parts = 5, each part = £60 ÷ 5 = £12, so Ben gets 3 × £12 = £36.

questions.q: y is directly proportional to x, and y = 12 when x = 3. What is y when x = 7?
5 identical pens cost £3.50. How much do 8 of these pens cost?
questions.explain: One pen costs £3.50 ÷ 5 = £0.70, so 8 pens cost 8 × £0.70 = £5.60.

questions.q: £500 is invested at 10% compound interest per year. What is it worth after 2 years?
A block has mass 240 g and volume 30 cm^3. What is its density?
It takes 6 taps 20 minutes to fill a tank. How long would 8 taps of the same flow take?
questions.explain: Total = 6 × 20 = 120 tap-minutes, so 8 taps take 120 ÷ 8 = 15 minutes.

questions.q: Simplify the ratio 12 : 18 to its simplest form.
questions.explain: Divide both parts by the highest common factor 6 to get 2 : 3.

questions.q: A coat costing £80 is reduced to £60 in a sale. What is the percentage decrease?
A map has a scale of 1 : 50000. Two towns are 4 cm apart on the map. What is the real distance?
